description: From the west bank the Sint Servaasbrug crosses the Meuse on seven limestone arches, with a steel lift span at the Wyck end and a small cabin on a pier. Lamps run along the deck. The sky is clear, about 14.7°C, with wind near 10.8 km/h, and a bright moon is up. The basilica is behind the camera, and the old gatehouses are gone.
